summary: Let users reset a forgotten password by email so they no longer need to contact support.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a registered email, when a reset is requested, then a single-use link valid for 1 hour is emailed.
Given an expired or used link, when it is opened, then the page says so and offers a new link.

assumptions.text: The existing mailer can send transactional email.

open_questions: Should a reset log the user out of other sessions?
